build.beforeBuildCommand: bash -c 'cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && sh platform/desktop/make-icons.sh && node platform/desktop/build-runtime.mjs'

security.csp: default-src 'self' http://127.0.0.1:3080; connect-src 'self' http://127.0.0.1:3080 ws://127.0.0.1:3080; img-src 'self' data: blob:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'
